mentions.name: modernc
mentions.description: An open-source compiler that translates TypeScript programs into C++, aiming to produce human-quality code. Includes a playground for trying it out and welcomes issues on the repository.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a open source typescript to cpp compiler that can write human quality code for typescript programs. The code and playground are available at https://github.com/developbharat/modernc
